advisory.finding: ADR 0105's new consequence bullet states as completed fact that the one-time cutover 're-seeded/rotated' the exposed crown-jewel secrets, but the ticket it cites as evidence (097b-de23-bf12-4c38) records that only the internally self-regenerable secret /rebar/prod/mcp-hmac-signing-key was rotated and the crown-jewels (Anthropic API key, jira-api-token, Gerrit admin/bot credentials, SSH host/private keys, opcert/rebar-bot signing keys, Google OAuth secret) were deliberately NOT rotated but flagged for operator rotation, with external rotation tracked in follow-up auspicial-wily-warbler. The ADR current-state claim overstates completion against its own named source.
